result.topic_en: Faint pencil calculations with a small circle sketch marking the points 0 and ∞, apparently studying a fractional expression in η²+1/η² involving a cube root of unity ρ (with ρ+ρ²=−1, ρ−ρ²=(α/2)i), perhaps as a linear fractional substitution.
result.transcription:
$0 \quad \infty \quad 0 \qquad\qquad \infty$
$\eta^2+\frac{1}{\eta^2}$[?]

[-...-] $\frac{\eta^2+\frac{1}{\eta^2}+\alpha i}{\eta^2+\frac{1}{\eta^2}-\alpha i}$ $\quad z=\frac{\eta^2+\frac{1}{\eta^2}+2(\rho-\rho^2)}{\eta^2+\frac{1}{\eta^2}+2(\rho^2-\rho)}$

$1.\quad \frac{2+\alpha i}{2-\alpha i}$ [?] $\frac{-2-\alpha i}{+2+\alpha i}$ $\qquad \frac{2(1+\rho-\rho^2)}{1+\rho^2-\rho}$

$2+\alpha i=\rho$ $\qquad \frac{-2\rho^2}{-2\rho}$

[-$\frac{1}{2}+\frac{\alpha i}{4}$-] $=\rho$

$\rho+\rho^2=-1$
$\rho-\rho^2=\frac{\alpha}{2}i$
$1+\frac{\alpha}{2}i$
